data.title: 朝田诗乃 · 玻璃海滩的耳机假日
data.description: 【海滨玻璃海滩·午后】诗乃穿着蓝灰运动泳装，坐在折叠沙滩椅上调试防水耳机；她把一只耳机递向镜头分享海浪声，另一只手压住被风吹起的短外套，眼神比游戏里更放松。
data.action: 沙滩椅上调试防水耳机，把一只耳机递向镜头分享海浪声
data.lighting: soft afternoon sun reflected on calm water
data.mood: 脱离任务后的轻松连接
data.promptProse: Shino Asada sits on a folding chair at the sea-glass beach, checking waterproof headphones before offering one earpiece toward the viewer. Her other hand holds down the pale windbreaker above a slate-blue athletic swimsuit and utility pouch. The horizontal medium view includes colored pebbles at her feet and calm water behind. Soft afternoon sun brightens ash-brown hair and headphone edges, with water reflections touching the chair's shaded metal frame.
